_comment: Golden planning-accuracy cases. Catalog = the four UtilityBackend caps (time, random_int, reverse, string_length) PLUS the harder fixture caps in planner_caps.json (translate, chat x2 peers, web_search, fetch_url, summarize, extract_keywords, convert_currency, weather_forecast). Add cases freely — the harness reads this file at runtime; no recompile needed. `expect_tools` is the exact multiset of capability names the compiled plan should call ([] = answer directly, no tools). `category`: single | multi | chain | none | trap | disambig. `disambig` cases are ones where more than one cap is superficially plausible and the correct choice is stated in the cap's `disambiguation` field. Set PLANNER_EVAL_CATALOG=basic to run against the utility caps only.
